dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Jun 30 2026
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000t978](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000t978) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 35.0 depth occurred on Jun 30 2026 20km W of Guama. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -5.727 longitude 150.9338. It impacted 44475 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
